product_metadata.title: Portion Control Serving Spoon, Cooking Utensils, Set of 8, Weight Loss Bariatric Diet, Gastric Sleeve, Bariatric Surgery Must Haves, Cooking Spoons and Skimmers Set, 4 Solid & 4 Perforated, Cucharas
features: Portion Control: Our 8-piece cooking utensils set with a range of serving ladles (2oz, 4oz, 6oz, 8oz) in two styles, solid-bottom and slotted to easily drain liquids. For controlling food portions.
Bariatric Serving Spoons: Cooking utensils for portion control post bariatric or gastric sleeve surgery. These portion control spoons are great bariatric utensils to control intake post surgery.
Versatile: Our restaurant serving spoons are perfect for serving, catering, parties, buffets, home, restaurants, cafeterias, hotels, weddings, and for people trying to control weight and diet.

Easy to Identify - A color coded system to grab the right serving spoon in a hurry. These portion control serving utensils also have a little hook on the handle to rest on the side of the serving dish
High grade stainless steel - to endure years in the kitchen with plastic handles for an easy & cool grip. This cooking utensils set is an essential gastric bypass must haves. Get the right portion!
